verdict: Leads are arriving, but cost per lead is rising and none are converting.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 122 leads from Meta at an average cost of $11.15 per lead — a solid volume, but cost per lead climbed 17% week-over-week as spend grew nearly twice as fast as lead volume. More pressing: all 122 leads entered the pipeline and zero converted to a scheduled appointment, which points to a drop-off in how leads are being followed up, not a problem with the ads themselves. Google Business Profile activity also fell sharply this past week, and we are investigating what caused that drop to make sure your local presence stays intact. On the intake side, we are working through the calendar and follow-up setup so that leads coming in have a clear path to a booked visit. The August milestone review at month-end is the next major checkpoint, and the work needed to reach it is underway now.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days via Meta ads
average cost per lead this period, up 17% from the prior week
actions on your Google Business Profile this period — calls, direction requests, and site clicks

watch_item.issue: 122 leads arrived over 28 days with zero converting to a booked appointment — the gap is in lead follow-up, not ad delivery.
watch_item.fix: We are configuring calendar availability and the intake workflow in your CRM so incoming leads route to a scheduled visit; doctor hours and calendar setup are being completed this month.
